name: french-multilingual-reward-bench-dpo
description: A French and multilingual reward-model / preference dataset intended for training and evaluating reward models (DPO-style) and preference predictors. It contains paired comparisons or preference labels across French (and other languages) model outputs to measure how well reward models predict human-like preferences. Useful for alignment, RLHF, and multilingual preference modeling research.
reputation: A community-contributed dataset on Hugging Face with modest visibility; useful for francophone alignment work but not yet a broadly adopted standard.
